Version 1.1.1

- Expanded and updated the list of available image models with detailed descriptions for each, including newly documented models and capabilities.
- Clarified use cases and feature distinctions for each model to help users select the most suitable option.
- No changes to the core logic or API usage—documentation updates only.

- Added authentication via device-code flow using `dlazy login`, providing a more convenient login method.
- Clarified alternative manual API key setup options.
- Added a detailed section on CLI pipe referencing for chaining `dlazy` commands.
- Updated some example command invocations and references (e.g., changed `mj.imagine` to `mj-imagine`).
- Improved documentation and organization for easier onboarding.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Improved agent instructions for handling API key errors: agent should now save the user's key using the CLI and resume the task automatically.
- Clarified error handling steps in documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md, SKILL-en.md, and SKILL-cn.md for better guidance and consistency.

- Updated required dlazy CLI version to 1.0.6 in installation instructions.
- No other functional or documentation changes.

- Added explicit API key authentication instructions, including CLI setup and key retrieval steps.
- Updated documentation to clarify all requests require API key configuration.
- No changes to command usage or available image models.

Initial release of dlazy-image-generate skill.

- Adds automated selection of optimal dlazy CLI image model based on prompt.
- Supports multiple styles: realism, sketch, general text-to-image, minimalist, stylized illustration, SVG/vector, Midjourney, and high-fidelity models.
- Includes detailed error handling with user guidance for authorization and balance issues.
- Installation via npm (`@dlazy/cli@1.0.5`) required.
- Provides usage instructions and model-specific trigger keywords.
